decision_owner: Delegated by user; product decision made during feed/profile implementation

active_release.ui: The publishing flow explicitly says publication and viewing are free. It publishes selected visual pages, not editable source albums.

future_style_market_decision.sale_object: Reusable, editable, creator-owned layout/style without private photos or personal writing
future_style_market_decision.price_model: Platform fixed introductory price, with creator choice of free or paid
future_style_market_decision.price_basis: Initial product judgement, not validated demand or a claimed market average. Below official story templates at 1800P, comparable to individual materials at 100-400P.
future_style_market_decision.reward_basis: Verified paid usage after cancellation/refund reconciliation; no rewards for raw likes, follows, free imports or self-purchases
future_style_market_decision.creator_reward_amount: Not activated or fixed in this release; unit costs and reversal rules must be verified before introducing rewards
launch_requirements: Actual editable reusable style with matching preview
Ownership and redistribution permission for all included assets
One entitlement per purchaser/style, idempotent purchase and atomic balance handling
Source attribution and basic abuse controls

reasons: Free discovery reduces friction when the community is still establishing works and followers.
Current public work files are viewing images, so charging for reuse would promise a product that does not yet exist.
A fixed introductory style price is easy to compare and avoids arbitrary price competition before there is demand data.

design_references.applied_direction: Photography first, clear portfolio flow, concise profile identity
Images and visible refinement controls support discovery

scope_protection: Existing official catalog prices, point products, customer wallets, entitlements and saved albums are unchanged.
